title: Teens, School & Homework Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=canvas:assignment) OR (index=personal sourcetype=khan:sat)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="canvas:assignment","primary",sourcetype="khan:sat","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from canvas:assignment and khan:sat to see whether two teens, school feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `canvas:assignment` and `khan:sat` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main teens, school data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
